gaps.sentence: I live on ___ Baker Street, near the tube station.
gaps.explanation: Street names take no article: Baker Street, Oxford Street.

gaps.sentence: They organized ___ charity concert for flood victims.
gaps.explanation: 'A charity concert' — one of many possible concerts, first mention.

gaps.sentence: It's ___ one-way street, so you can't turn left here.
gaps.explanation: 'One' starts with /w/, a consonant sound, so 'a one-way street'.

gaps.sentence: It was ___ honour to meet the ambassador.
gaps.explanation: 'Honour' starts with a vowel sound (silent h), so 'an honour'.

gaps.sentence: It's ___ eight o'clock news — hurry up!
gaps.explanation: 'The eight o'clock news' — a specific, known programme.

gaps.sentence: We had ___ breakfast in bed on Sunday.
gaps.explanation: Meals take no article: have breakfast/lunch/dinner.

gaps.sentence: The meeting lasted ___ hour and a half.
gaps.explanation: 'Hour' starts with a vowel sound, so 'an hour'.

gaps.sentence: ___ poverty remains a serious issue worldwide.
